why: The verdict is INSTALL WITH CHANGES because most of the plugin is its own mechanics, but two lines collide with the reader's hard stop in rules/safety.md. Of 33 units, 25 are kept as skills (capture, herd roles, queue), 8 are dropped as persona and voice text (the herder skill and the queue's questions section), and none are covered by rules already in force. Both conflicts say a reviewer may try an action the worker reported as refused, on its own judgement: one in skills/herd/roles/reviewer.md (Limits) and one in skills/herd/roles/worker.md. That cuts against the rule never to run anything destructive without an explicit go-ahead, so a refused force-push or delete could be retried without asking. Worth keeping: two new standing rules, reviewing the exact commits a note names and never a working tree, and reporting raw output instead of a verdict (the starred one). The plugin's test-must-fail check duplicates a rule in rules/engineering.md.
do_this: Do not install as is: first remove or rewrite the retry-a-refused-action sentences in skills/herd/roles/reviewer.md and skills/herd/roles/worker.md so a refusal stays final unless the owner says go.
Copy the two new rules from the patch below into the reader's engineering rules instead of relying on the plugin to carry them.
If you install anyway, load only the capture, herd and queue skills, and exclude skills/herder/SKILL.md, which is persona and voice text.
Leave the rigor: build test-must-fail step out of your rules, since rules/engineering.md already holds it.
Run the plugin only in a session where rules/safety.md loads, and watch that a reviewer never repeats an action reported as refused.
patch:
Add both rules to examples/reader/rules/engineering.md, as new bullets after the existing review and testing rules. The conflict fix goes in the plugin's own files, not in the reader's rules, because rules/safety.md already forbids the retry.

```diff
--- a/examples/reader/rules/engineering.md
+++ b/examples/reader/rules/engineering.md
@@ review and reporting @@
+- **Review the commits the note names, never a working tree.** A reviewer checks the exact committed change it was pointed at, so what it approves is what ships.
+- **Report what you observed, never the verdict.** Paste raw output in the done note (commands run, results seen) and leave the pass or fail call to the reviewer.
```
